acceptance_rows.reference_semantics: Codex AgentControl owns spawn/send/membership and separates delivery acceptance from model consumption; DeepSeek SubagentManager serializes child admission, capacity and disposal through one activation map.
pig_invariants: AgentRuntime is the sole authority for Agent/Run/Attempt lineage, capacity and terminal state across local, nested and IPC execution.
The command loop commits facts serially without holding a lock across await; stale attempts, duplicate settlement and late events cannot change a newer run.

acceptance_rows.area: Agent, Run, Attempt and ExecutionHandle semantics
acceptance_rows.reference_semantics: DeepSeek binds result and idempotent disposal to one activation rather than a later resume; Codex releases execution capacity through a scoped guard. Pig additionally distinguishes a new resume Run from a reconnect Attempt.
pig_invariants: ExecutionHandle send/stop/reconnect/events/result/release is capability-checked and attempt-fenced.
Run settlement is distinct from release; release awaits backend quiescence and repeated release is idempotent.

acceptance_rows.area: Durable control state, mailbox and conversation recovery
acceptance_rows.reference_semantics: DeepSeek JSONL persistence serializes contiguous appends, repairs a torn tail and never returns a shorter observed prefix; continuation messages carry durable sender attribution and terminal outcome as model-visible input.
pig_invariants: SQLite transactions own control state, mailbox/outbox/receipts and recovery metadata; JSONL owns model history with stable message IDs.
Mailbox queued/claimed/consumed recovery reconciles against logged message IDs so a model-visible delivery occurs exactly once without a duplicate wake.

acceptance_rows.area: Stop, delete, quiescence and bounded cleanup
acceptance_rows.reference_semantics: Codex closes tree admission, joins members and records bounded teardown failures; DeepSeek and Kimi bind cancellation and disposal to the exact live child and await process quiescence.
pig_invariants: Graceful and force stop produce deterministic terminal states; deletion persists pending work and retries cleanup instead of deleting live artifacts or waiting forever on an uncooperative backend.
Execution release, AgentHandle close and process-tree teardown leave no writer, reservation, orphan process or unrecoverable deletion.

acceptance_rows.area: Control journal, projections and consistent resync
acceptance_rows.reference_semantics: DeepSeek RemoteJournalStream publishes a cursor-bound snapshot before live entries, repairs gaps and rejects discontinuous or old generations; Kimi buffers live events while the initial page is read, then flushes them in order.
pig_invariants: All catalog, task, conversation, UI and plugin views derive from ordered run/sequence facts; a resync snapshot and its cursor are committed atomically.
Duplicate, out-of-order and stale-epoch input cannot regress projections; replayable cursors continue in order and expired cursors return ResyncRequired with one consistent snapshot.

acceptance_rows.reference_semantics: DeepSeek starts an independent runtime over stdio JSON-RPC, flattens child terminal results and disposes to process quiescence; Kimi selects remote capabilities rather than treating a transport failure as local process loss.
pig_invariants: The registered ipc backend runs the real pig-agent-worker in production, including start, send/steer, stop, reconnect and release; unsupported capabilities fail before start.
Disconnect and root/worker restart reconcile durable inputs, cursor-deduplicated output and terminal results; stale attempts cannot settle a replacement run.

acceptance_rows.reference_semantics: Codex creates a turn-scoped streaming client with explicit model, reasoning, usage and retry behavior; Kimi exposes typed provider/model capability boundaries rather than session-specific format branches.
pig_invariants: Registered providers share contracts for streaming, reasoning, media, structured output, usage, cancellation, timeout and business errors, with explicit malformed/empty/finish classification.
Transient transport recovery does not blindly replay a side-effecting Run; a new provider registers through configuration and contract implementation without Runtime/Session special cases.

acceptance_rows.reference_semantics: DeepSeek tools use typed schemas and its out-of-process run seam settles cancellation/failure without rejecting the result; it caps diagnostic data and requires an enterable absolute cwd before spawning.
pig_invariants: Tools carry typed inputs, structured errors, cancellation, timeout and bounded/spillable output; their durable results remain linked to the exact call.
A transport or crash interruption distinguishes completed, failed and unknown side effects and never silently repeats an unknown write.

acceptance_rows.reference_semantics: Kimi computes permission policy before tool execution and binds decisions to agent/turn context; DeepSeek applies a shared per-call filesystem policy in platform backends and only widens it through an approved one-time escalation.
pig_invariants: The actual execution point enforces workspace trust, read/write roots, network, credentials and fail-closed sandbox availability; prompts and tool descriptions are not the security boundary.

Approval requests carry session/agent/run/turn/call, structured action, cwd and permission snapshot; User and deterministic Policy reviewers share Allow/Deny/Defer/Abort, timeout and cancellation semantics.

acceptance_rows.reference_semantics: Codex owns cancellable task execution and interruption; DeepSeek owns managed child-range teardown, bounded waits and output lifecycle through its subprocess seam.
pig_invariants: ShellTask state is separate from AgentRun; process trees support graceful/force stop and restart-loss classification.
Background output is bounded and spill-recoverable, task notification failure is observable, and terminal cleanup joins the real child tree.

acceptance_rows.area: Context, compaction, cache identity and replay
acceptance_rows.reference_semantics: Kimi records compaction operations, restores their wire ranges, tracks usage and retries bounded overflow recovery; Codex separates compacted history from a fresh request and preserves stable replay prefixes.
pig_invariants: Fresh/fork/resume/replay and compaction retain model-visible history, paired tool exchanges, media references and usage watermarks.
Reactive overflow recovery compacts before retrying the model and never repeats an already-executed side effect; capability changes deliberately refresh cache identity.

acceptance_rows.reference_semantics: Kimi SessionMediaStore gives durable media IDs typed content, streams, ranges and materialization; model input capabilities determine which attachments can be projected.
pig_invariants: Image/PDF type, size and capability checks run before model submission; attachment references survive fork/resume/replay without embedding stale raw bytes in ordinary history.
Missing or corrupt media degrade with an explicit model-visible note rather than changing unrelated history or silently claiming the model saw it.

acceptance_rows.area: Plugin, MCP and SDK capability seams
acceptance_rows.reference_semantics: DeepSeek exposes a complete runtime over newline-delimited JSON-RPC with typed requests/results/notifications; Kimi exposes scoped client capabilities and disposable subscriptions.
pig_invariants: Plugin/SDK calls are typed, versioned and capability-scoped; storage has scoped atomic revisions, and disposal cannot remove a newer registration.
Plugin sessions, agent views and events use the same Runtime/projection path; MCP and plugins cannot bypass workspace or permission enforcement.
automated_tests: App.plugin-sdk::disposers are single-shot and cannot remove a newer same-name registration

acceptance_rows.reference_semantics: Kimi registers configuration sections, applies scoped overlays and plans atomic writeback; DeepSeek settings separate typed schema, environment binding and durable updates.
pig_invariants: Configuration is validated at the earliest boundary with actionable errors; persisted state and live Runtime are refreshed from the same accepted value.
Credential values never enter normal logs, snapshots or ordinary event errors; file/plugin stores use bounded, atomic, isolated writes.

acceptance_rows.area: Structured errors, observability and bounded retention
acceptance_rows.reference_semantics: Codex carries typed protocol errors with operation context; DeepSeek agent-loop and provider seams preserve bounded diagnostics, terminal reasons and safe error categories.
pig_invariants: Core errors preserve applicable session/agent/run/attempt/call identity and never silently drop journal, task-notification or cleanup failures.
Queues, output, journal and durable history have explicit bounds; cleanup failures remain retryable and sensitive payloads do not enter ordinary diagnostics.

acceptance_rows.reference_semantics: DeepSeek registers independent subagent providers behind one manager contract; Kimi adds domain features and lifecycle behavior through scoped services rather than another core authority.
pig_invariants: Representative provider, tool, backend, projection, custom mailbox, schedule initiator and approval-policy extensions use public registration/contracts only.
Extensions do not mutate Runtime internals, add provider/backend branches to Session, create a second notification authority or bypass cancellation, persistence and permission gates.

acceptance_rows.reference_semantics: Kimi statically rejects environment bypasses and unscoped execution; DeepSeek package contracts put process, persistence and extension ownership behind explicit seams.
pig_invariants: CI rejects domain-owned Runtime state, legacy dual control writes, provider/backend Session branches, unbounded provider/runtime channels and production permission bypasses.
Inventory and verified delivery evidence are machine-checked; status cannot substitute for missing semantics, named tests or successful platform proof.

acceptance_rows.area: Crate host API and public lifecycle surface
acceptance_rows.reference_semantics: Codex ThreadManager owns startup, resume, history and tree shutdown behind host-facing APIs; Kimi Session services own creation, persistence, workdir and lifecycle scopes.
pig_invariants: AgentHandle exposes one operation channel, event stream, journal and credential surface, with shared idempotent close/close_blocking lifecycle.
Public core entries are inventoried; fresh/fork/resume and replayed histories pass through the same Session and Runtime rather than host-only shortcuts.

acceptance_rows.reference_semantics: Codex centralizes platform-specific process construction while leaving lifetime and stdio to its caller; Kimi exposes host behavior through OS backends rather than scattering platform branches through the core.
pig_invariants: Git/workspaces, fonts, networking, terminals and sandbox diagnostics stay isolated behind core/platform modules; unsupported capabilities produce explicit errors.
The same Rust and NSH contracts run on macOS, Windows and Linux without skipping required executor, lifecycle or UI steps.
